summary.text: Shannon Kessler is the Republican candidate for California State Assembly District 30 in the November 3, 2026 general election, where she is running against incumbent Democrat Dawn Addis.
She is a real estate broker who describes herself as a mother, business owner and Central Coast children's and parental rights advocate.

paragraphs.text: Kessler earned a diploma from Sky High School and works as a real estate broker.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she is a co-owner of a local family construction company and real estate business and a sixth-generation member of a California agriculture family.
She said she has served as an Arroyo Grande Parks and Recreation Commissioner, a PTA president and a 4-H leader, and that she founded a Central Coast group focused on girls' sports.
Kessler and Addis advanced from the June 2, 2026 nonpartisan primary, in which Addis received 54.8 percent, Kessler 35.9 percent and Democrat Susannah Brown 9.3 percent.

In the survey, Kessler listed her campaign messages as reducing the cost of living and focusing on the local economy; public safety, homelessness and mental health; and environment, energy and the Central Coast.
